messages:
talia: quick one from the obs follow-up meeting: how do we actually surface cost for prefix-cache hits and model-proxy routing so billing & SLOs both make sense
ren: short answer: we need lightweight, deterministic signals emitted where the cost is incurred (proxy / cache layer) and a simple rollup path to billing keys
omar: agree. my worry is adding lots of heavy attrs will bloat traces and hurt ingest. propose a tiny counter metric on the span AND a compact tag for enrichment
jay: sketch: each cache/proxy span emits `rw.costs_v1` which is a compact semi-colon list: `cache:mem_bytes=12345|mem_ms=20;compute:tokens=56`. cheap to parse and small
talia: that format looks fine. prefer pipe for sub-kv so it's unambiguous. also we should emit a numeric `rw.cost_sum_hint` (single float) for quick SLO math before enrichment finishes
ren: +1 to both. `rw.cost_sum_hint` = estimated $ cents or normalized cost unit. pipelines can use it for realtime dashboards without waiting for full enrichment
omar: sampling: we can't write the full `rw.costs_v1` on every debug trace. we should do stratified reservoir sampling keyed by billing-key+model_id with tunable rate. if sampled, keep the full tag; if not, keep only `rw.cost_sum_hint`
jay: also add deterministic sampling for customer-initiated tracing (user opt-in) so support can get complete bills for specific requests
talia: policy on sensitive ids: origin span ids or session ids should be hashed or dropped based on team-retention policy. infra-bot can we annotate defaults?
infra-bot: retention-defaults: traces 30d, long-term billing attrs 90d if flagged, sensitive span ids masked after 7d. open ticket INFRA-872 to add per-team overrides
ren: enrichment path: tracer -> kafka topic `trace-enrich` -> enrichment job attaches billing_key, aggregates `rw.costs_v1` into `billing.cost_breakdown` and emits `billing.total_est_cents`. That becomes canonical for chargeback
omar: cornercase: streaming/patched responses where model tokens arrive after cache hits. we should allow multiple cost items across spans and let enricher sum by origin tag. `rw.costs_v1` should include optional origin token like `o=span1234`
jay: format example for implementers: ```rw.costs_v1=cache:o=spanA|mem_bytes=4096|mem_ms=5;compute:o=spanB|tokens=34```
talia: nice. one more: observability backends sometimes choke on long strings. add fallback compressed attr `rw.cost_compact` that keeps only kind:units:value pairs `cache:bytes:4096,compute:tokens:34`
ren: so final rules: 1) emit `rw.cost_sum_hint` always (numeric), 2) emit `rw.costs_v1` when not sampled lightly (sampled by billing-key stratification) or in debug mode, 3) emit `rw.cost_compact` as a universal short fallback, 4) enricher will convert to `billing.cost_breakdown` and `billing.total_est_cents`
omar: i'll draft the enrichment pseudocode and include cost model calibration notes (per-GPU mem-ms pricing + token ops). ren can add sampling formulas
jay: i'll put a tiny linter for `rw.costs_v1` format in the proxy repo so bad producers fail CI
talia: schedule: draft short RFC with examples, add infra ticket for retention overrides (INFRA-872), add proxy linter PR. pinging @ren @omar for commits. :thumbsup:
